title: BGISeq-500 Library Construction Protocol
author: SARAH SIU TZE MAK
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iamcac6
materials: To determine the number of cycles used in index PCR, performe a qPCR in a 20 µl reaction volume using 1:20 dilution of: purified library template 0.2 mM dNTPs (Invitrogen) 0.04 U/µl AmpliTaq Gold DNA polymerase (Applied Biosystems, Foster City, California, USA) 2.5 mM MgCl2 (Applied Biosystems) 1X GeneAmp® 10X PCR Buffer II (Applied Biosystems) 1 µl SYBR Green (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, California, USA) 0.2 µM forward and reverse primers mixture(CommonprimerBGI forward primer and one of the indexed reverse primers) (Supplemental Table S4) 13.48 µl AccuGene molecular biology water (Lonza)

100 µl PCR reactions containing: 20 µl of purified library 0.2 mM dNTPs (Invitrogen) 0.1 U/µl AmpliTaq Gold DNA polymerase (Applied Biosystems) 2.5 mM MgCl2 (Applied Biosystems) 1X GeneAmp® 10X PCR Buffer II (Applied Biosystems) 0.4 mg/ml BSA (New England Biolabs Inc) 0.2 µM of each forward (CommonprimerBGI forward primer) indexed reverse primers (Supplemental Table S4) 51.2 µl AccuGene molecular biology water (Lonza, Basel, CH)
Post-PCR, purify libraries with QiaQuick columns (Qiagen).

steps.title: End‑repair with enhancer
steps.instruction: Perform the end‑repair reaction as described by Carøe et al. 2017 and add 1 µL of reaction enhancer composed of 25 % PEG 4000, 2 µg/µL BSA, and 400 mM NaCl.

steps.title: Ligation with adapters
steps.instruction: Carry out the ligation step (Carøe et al. 2017) using 1 µL of 10 µM BGISeq‑500 adapters (Supplemental Table S4).

steps.title: Adapter fill‑in reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the fill‑in reaction to complete adapter synthesis as described by Carøe et al. 2017.

steps.title: Purify fill‑in product
steps.instruction: Purify the fill‑in reaction using a 1:5 (v/v) volume of Qiagen PB binding buffer and Monarch DNA Cleanup Columns (NEB).

substeps.instruction: Add PB binding buffer at a 1:5 volume ratio to the reaction.
Load the mixture onto a Monarch DNA Cleanup Column.
Wash the column with 750 µL Qiagen Buffer PE.
Incubate the column for 5 min at 37 °C.
Elute the purified DNA in 40 µL Qiagen Buffer EB.

steps.title: Quantitative PCR (qPCR)
steps.instruction: Run qPCR on the purified library using an Agilent MX3005 with the following cycling conditions: 1 cycle – 95 °C 10 min; 40 cycles – 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 60 s, 72 °C 60 s.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the library with the following PCR program: initial denaturation 95 °C 12 min; 13–21 cycles – 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 40 s; final elongation 72 °C 5 min.

steps.title: Post‑PCR incubation and elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the PCR product for 10 min at 37 °C, then elute in 30 µL Qiagen Buffer EB.

steps.title: Initial library quantification
steps.instruction: Take a small aliquot of the eluted library and assess concentration and fragment size using the Agilent High‑Sensitivity DNA Assay on a Bioanalyzer 2100.

steps.title: Extra purification with AMPure XP
steps.instruction: Purify the library with AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter) at a 1.8 × beads‑to‑library volume ratio to remove primer dimers and fragments < 100 bp.

steps.title: Post‑purification quantification
steps.instruction: Again use a small aliquot to measure concentration and fragment size with the Agilent High‑Sensitivity DNA Assay on a Bioanalyzer 2100.

steps.title: Aliquot and optional second cleanup
steps.instruction: Split each purified library into two ~12.5 µL aliquots; subject one aliquot to an additional AMPure XP purification to eliminate any residual primer dimers.
